name: Group Notify
description: Emails group members when content is added.
project_description:
Notify (email) members of a Group ( https://www.drupal.org/project/group ) when new group content is posted via Group Node plugins.

 Once the module has been enabled, browse to Administration -> Groups -> Group types -> Set available content. Plugins provided by "Group Node" (gnode) can be enabled to send email notifications. Click "Install" or "Configure" and check "Notify group members" to enable.

 If you experience a slowdown when saving a group node (lots of members to notify, perhaps) I suggest using the queue_mail module to mitigate this.
